fingerprint.bandicam: full version, no watermark, no time cap

interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game of Pro for the full recording. The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks, no per-case discipline.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build (V0 set, four-seat default, seat 1 human). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. Recording starts at the title splash; first in-game frame is the opening deal.

observations.value: Once you have selected the three cards click on the green [Trade in Cards] button. You can only hold 5 cards in your hand at once. If you have more then 5, the computer will ask which card you want to discard. Click on the card to eliminate, to make room for you new card.
